text:
maria (sales): FYI Montara wants to run the POC but procurement asked for PO split by legal entity and wants proof the invoice attachments are tamper-proof/encrypted. Can legal + finance advise on signature mapping and whether we do one orderform or two?

sam (legal): Please paste their redlines or upload. Need to know if both entities are signatories or if GC signing once is sufficient. Also flagging DPA clauses.

maria (sales): Uploaded here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/links/montara-redline-2026. They call for: tenant-scoped PO numbers, separate invoice lines, and HSM-wrapped attachment receipts for each invoice PDF.

kevin (finance): Our billing supports a single orderform with multiple billing blocks. If they insist on separate PO numbers per entity, we map them to GL codes. If they want two orderforms we issue two separate invoices (affects payment terms). Ask Montara for preferred net terms and bank routing per entity.

montara-poc: (Montara) Prefer single MSA signed by GC, separate POs per entity, Net30, and an invoice receipt token we can verify in AP. They want the invoice PDF envelope to be HSM-wrapped.

lee (solutions): Technically doable. Proposal: single orderform with two billing sections, each with tenant_id and PO. On our invoice API we can include a receipt token (sha256) and an HSM envelope id in metadata. Example snippet we can provide to their AP:```
Receipt JSON:
{
  "tenant_id": "montara-research",
  "po_number": "MR-2026-044",
  "invoice_hash": "sha256:...",
  "ts": "2026-03-23T18:04:00Z",
  "envelope_id": "env_abc123"
}
```
This lets their AP validate the PDF matches the hash.

sam (legal): If both entities are under the same contracting umbrella, single MSA + appendix mapping PO->entity + GC sig should be fine. I'll prepare an appendix template and adjust indemnity/processor language for the DPA redlines. If their redlines require processor-level changes we may ask for an SOC addendum.

olivia (sales-eng): Operational ask: if we go single orderform we should include signer-routing metadata in the orderflow so their finance/GC/exec signers get routed correctly: billing_signer -> finance@montara, legal_signer -> gc@montara, exec_signer -> ceo@montara. Keeps approvals auditable.

kevin (finance): Two bookkeeping notes: 1) need explicit PO->GL mapping from Montara. 2) Confirm whether ACH/wire details differ per entity (we support entity-level bank info). Also confirm Net30.

maria (sales): I'll request PO numbers + bank details and confirm Net30. Sam 12 can you draft the MSA appendix + clean orderform with two billing blocks + invoice-receipt clause?

sam (legal): On it. Will post redline + appendix by EOD showing: "PO routing and entity mapping" and an invoicing clause that requires receipt token verification and outlines HSM envelope expectations.

lee (solutions): HSM note: we support key wrapping and can issue envelope ids. SLA: 99.9% availability, envelope TTL 90 days. Will attach API spec and a sample curl to fetch receipt metadata.

olivia (sales-eng): Sample curl for AP to verify receipt (we'll include in the doc):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/receipt/env_abc123
```
(we'll correct endpoint typos before sending).

kevin (finance): Also need to confirm invoice numbering format if Montara wants their PO embedded in our invoice number for reconciliation.

montara-poc: We can provide PO numbers and GL codes by tomorrow morning. AP wants verification to be automatic if possible.

maria (sales): Great. Next steps: Sam posts redline + appendix; Montara sends PO numbers + bank details; Lee posts API spec and confirms envelope workflow; Kevin will map GL codes once we have PO mapping. I'll loop back and route final orderform for signature once ready. :thumbsup:
